title: Massachusetts AG Joins Effort to Protect AI Chatbot Data
description: (TNS) — The bankruptcy of a popular AI chatbot platform is drawing scrutiny from attorneys general across the country, including Massachusetts, seeking assurances that sensitive user data, including conversations about mental health and personal relationships, will remain protected if the company is sold.
